overall_summary: Husband-wife and long-term relationship dynamics significantly outperform generic family shayari and poetry, pulling 10x more views (1,600+ vs 100-200). General family topics and aggressive sad shayari underperform due to lack of immediate psychological hook.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1666 views) are clear outliers with massive view counts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital friction, unspoken love, and household emotional realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed as a direct question about relationship stages drive higher curiosity and engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Use direct, probing questions regarding modern relationship struggles in titles.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 10 views, indicating heavy-handed poetry fails to connect on Shorts.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic framing; stick to grounded, everyday marital observations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos about sisters, brothers, and fathers without a specific relatable conflict averaged under 200 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus away from generic family members unless anchored to a specific emotional friction point.
